project.title: Leeds IR Consent Audit

evidence_tiers.Tier 1: Professional society guideline/standard or high-quality systematic review/meta-analysis
evidence_tiers.Tier 2: Large multicentre prospective study, major registry, randomised trial or audited national dataset
evidence_tiers.Tier 3: Large peer-reviewed cohort/retrospective series or good-quality peer-reviewed review
evidence_tiers.Tier 4: Established tertiary/high-volume centre or national patient information / reputable secondary clinical resource
evidence_tiers.Tier 5: Small case series, case report, older/indirect evidence or expert opinion
evidence_tiers.Unverified: No risk-level supporting source confirmed in the current evidence review
evidence_tiers.Local practice: Locally proposed common consent risk; no specific published source assigned

project.local_core_note: The same local generic policy is checked across procedures. Where a procedure-specific evidence item already represents a local-policy risk, that existing item is marked as also included in the local generic policy and is scored once only. A separate Local practice item is added only when the local-policy concept is not otherwise represented.
